capabilities: Annotate blocks, sections, or whole files
Search and manage annotations in a sidebar
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or later; on Obsidian 1.14+ new plain-text highlights use the native highlight format and stay visible when the plugin is disabled. No account or internet connection needed and no usage data collected. MIT licensed.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to highlight passages in multiple colors and attach editable comments to specific selections, blocks, or sections.
summary: Highlighting and annotation tool that marks text, blocks, sections, or whole notes with colored highlights and comments.
